[SWS_CM_00075] Deserializing incomplete data belonging to a field in case of
Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF
network binding
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00004
⌈
If less data than expected shall be deserialized and the data to be deserialized belong
to a
Field
, the
initValue
shall be used if it is defined. Otherwise the data shall be
completely discarded.
⌋
